title: Claiming and denying
about: Collocations for making and answering accusations and for presenting a point of view: drop heavy hints, make serious allegations, issue a statement, put forward a theory, back up an argument, strongly deny the rumours. Plus when to use deny, reject or refuse.

parts.title: Putting forward a point of view
Common mistakes
parts.note: Українські «заперечувати», «відкидати» і «відмовлятися» англійською — три різні дієслова, і їх легко сплутати. Deny — заперечувати, що щось правда: deny a claim, a rumour, an allegation, an accusation, deny doing sth, deny that… Reject — не прийняти, відхилити: reject a claim, an idea, a suggestion. Refuse — відмовитися від того, що пропонують (refuse an invitation, an offer), або відмовитися щось робити (refuse to do sth). Після deny — дієслово з -ing (про те, що вже сталося), після refuse — to + дієслово (зараз або в майбутньому).

rows: a claim / a rumour / an allegation / an accusation · doing sth · that …
He denied leaving the gate open.
a claim / an idea / a suggestion / a plan
They rejected our plan for the garden.
an invitation / an offer · to do sth
She refused to lend me her car.

items.pattern: be facing accusations of sth / of doing sth · face accusations that …
items.meaning: be accused, often publicly, of doing something wrong
items.uk: стикатися зі звинуваченнями; бути звинуваченим (у чомусь)
items.example: The owner of the new bakery is **facing accusations** of selling yesterday's bread as fresh.
more: Two nurses are **facing accusations** of sleeping during their night shifts.
The landlord is **facing accusations** that he kept the students' deposits.
items.watchOut: «Його звинувачують у шахрайстві» — he is facing accusations of cheating, з of, а не in. Після of — іменник або дієслово з -ing: accusations of taking money.

items.pattern: a heavy / broad hint · drop heavy / broad hints (about sth / as to sth)
items.meaning: a very obvious hint, so it's easy to guess what someone means
items.example: My daughter left a toy shop catalogue open on my desk. That was a pretty **heavy hint**.
more: Mum dropped a **broad hint** that she'd like us to visit more often.
The teacher gave us some **heavy hints** about what would be in the exam.
items.watchOut: «Прозорий натяк» — зазвичай a heavy або broad hint. A thick або fat hint («товстий / жирний натяк») — калька. Transparent hint трапляється рідко, краще heavy / broad. Також природно: a big / clear / obvious hint. Тонкий натяк — a subtle hint.

items.pattern: drop a hint / hints (about sth / as to sth / that …)
items.meaning: suggest something indirectly and hope the other person understands
items.example: My brother has been **dropping hints** about his birthday for weeks: he wants new headphones.
more: My colleague **dropped a hint** that the boss was in a bad mood.
If you want a pay rise, **dropping hints** won't work. Ask your manager directly.
items.watchOut: «Робити натяки» — зазвичай drop або give a hint, не do hints і не make hints. Зрозуміти натяк — take / get the hint: OK, I get the hint!

items.pattern: clearly imply (that) … · sth is clearly implied
items.meaning: make something very clear without saying it directly
items.example: My boss didn't say I hadn't got the promotion, but her email **clearly implied** it.
more: The look on his face **clearly implied** that he hated the soup.
The sign doesn't say 'No dogs', but it **clearly implies** that pets aren't welcome.
items.watchOut: Imply — натякати, мати на увазі (той, хто говорить). Не плутай з infer — робити висновок (той, хто слухає). Clearly imply — не сказати прямо, але так, що всім зрозуміло; сказати прямо — state clearly.

items.pattern: a leaked document / report / email · leak sth (to the press)
items.meaning: an official document that someone has secretly given to journalists
items.example: A **leaked document** shows that the town council wants to close two libraries.
more: The **leaked report** says that the hospital needs fifty more nurses.
Nobody knows who **leaked** the photos of the new stadium.
items.watchOut: «Злити інформацію в пресу» — leak sth to the press, не pour і не drain. Leaked тут — «таємно переданий журналістам», а не «протеклий».

items.pattern: make serious / grave allegations (about sth / against sb) · an allegation of sth / that …
items.meaning: say publicly that someone has done something wrong or illegal, before it is proved
items.example: Several customers have **made serious allegations** about the way the shop treats its staff.
more: Parents have **made serious allegations** against the driver of the school bus.
These are **serious allegations**, so we need proof before we go to the police.
items.watchOut: «Висувати звинувачення» — make allegations / accusations, не do; put forward кажуть передусім про теорії та ідеї (put forward a theory). Allegation — звинувачення, яке ще не доведено. «Серйозні, тяжкі звинувачення» — serious або grave allegations, не hard allegations.

items.pattern: openly accuse sb of sth / of doing sth
items.meaning: say directly and publicly that someone did something wrong
items.example: At the residents' meeting, one man **openly accused** his neighbour of stealing his parking space.
more: She **openly accused** the shop of selling fake trainers.
Nobody **openly accused** the new cleaner, but everyone was suspicious.
items.watchOut: Accuse sb OF sth, не in і не for: accused him of lying. Порівняй: blame sb FOR sth (blamed him for the mess), charge sb WITH sth (у поліції). Після of — дієслово з -ing.

items.pattern: issue / release a statement (about / on sth) · make a statement
items.meaning: officially give information or an opinion to the public, usually in writing
items.example: After the flood, the train company **issued a statement** apologising for the delays.
more: The school **issued a statement** saying that it would reopen on Monday.
The singer's family has **issued a statement** asking for privacy.
items.watchOut: «Зробити заяву» — make a statement; офіційно оприлюднити заяву (зазвичай письмову) — issue або release a statement. Не do a statement і не say a statement.

items.pattern: the claims / rumours / fears are unfounded · unfounded claims / allegations
items.meaning: not based on facts; not true
items.example: The café owner says the **claims are unfounded**: the inspectors found no mice in the kitchen.
more: Our fears were **unfounded**: the kids loved their new school from day one.
**Unfounded** stories about the new neighbours spread quickly round the village.
items.watchOut: Unfounded — безпідставний (від found — заснувати). Не плутай з unfunded — без фінансування. Те саме значення — groundless, baseless.

items.pattern: be wrongly / falsely accused (of sth / of doing sth)
items.meaning: blamed for something you did not do
items.example: I was **wrongly accused** of scratching my neighbour's car. I was on holiday that week!
more: He spent a year in prison after being **wrongly accused** of robbery.
My aunt was **wrongly accused** of shoplifting when the alarm went off by mistake.
items.watchOut: «Несправедливо звинувачений» — wrongly / falsely / unfairly accused, не badly accused. Прийменник той самий: accused of, а не in.

items.pattern: a long-running battle / dispute / argument (with sb / over sth)
items.meaning: a fight or disagreement that has gone on for a long time
items.example: Our neighbours have a **long-running battle** with the council over a tree in their garden.
more: After a **long-running battle** with her landlord, Sue finally got her deposit back.
The village's **long-running battle** to keep its post office open is finally over.
items.watchOut: Long-running — «який триває вже давно» (про суперечки, серіали, вистави: a long-running TV series). Не плутай з long-distance (на далеку відстань) і long-haul (далекий рейс).

items.pattern: put forward a theory / an idea / a plan / a suggestion · put a theory forward
items.meaning: suggest a theory or idea so that people can think about it
items.example: A scientist on the radio **put forward an interesting theory** about why some people never catch colds.
more: At the meeting, Kate **put forward an idea** for a cheaper school trip.
The police have **put forward** two **theories** about how the thief got into the house.
items.watchOut: «Висунути теорію / ідею» — put forward, а не move forward і не push out. Офіційніше — propose або advance a theory.

items.pattern: back up an argument / a claim / a theory (with sth) · back it up
items.meaning: show that an argument or claim is true by giving facts or evidence
items.example: If you want Dad to agree to a later bedtime, you'll have to **back up your argument** with good reasons.
more: She **backed up** her complaint with photos of the broken washing machine.
The research **backs up** what grandmothers have always said: sleep is the best medicine.
items.watchOut: Back up an argument — підкріпити фактами; back sb up — підтримати людину (My sister always backs me up). Займенник стоїть посередині: back it up, а не back up it.

items.pattern: fully accept sth / (the fact) that … · fully accept responsibility
items.meaning: agree completely that something is true, even if you don't like it
items.example: I **fully accept** that I was wrong, and I'll pay for the broken vase.
more: My dad **fully accepts the fact** that he can't run marathons any more.
We **fully accept** that the hotel was busy, but nobody cleaned our room for three days.
items.watchOut: Accept без прийменника: accept the fact that…, а не accept with. «Цілком визнаю» — I fully / completely accept, не I strongly accept: зі strongly зазвичай кажуть agree, disagree, deny.

items.pattern: make the point that … · make a (good / valid) point · make your point
items.meaning: say something important in a discussion; express an opinion clearly
items.example: My doctor **made the point** that walking the dog counts as exercise too.
more: She **made the point** that the bus is cheaper than the car.
Fair enough, you've **made your point**. Now let me speak.
items.watchOut: «Висловити думку, слушно зауважити» — make a point, не do a point і не say a point. Про слушну думку кажуть: That's a good point. / You've got a point.

items.pattern: it is widely acknowledged / accepted that … · be widely acknowledged as sth
items.meaning: accepted as true by many people
items.example: It's **widely acknowledged** that the city needs more cycle lanes.
more: Her apple pie is **widely acknowledged** as the best in the village.
It is now **widely acknowledged** that babies understand far more than we used to think.
items.watchOut: Вимова: acknowledge /əkˈnɒlɪdʒ/: ck читається як /k/, наголос на другому складі (-nowl- як у knowledge). «Загальновизнано» — widely acknowledged / accepted; highly acknowledged не кажуть (але highly regarded — «високо цінований»).

items.pattern: state clearly (that) … · clearly state sth
items.meaning: say or write something directly, so that there is no doubt
items.example: The rental contract **states clearly** that you can't keep pets in the flat.
more: The ticket **clearly states** that children under five travel free.
The teacher **stated clearly** that phones are not allowed in the exam room.
items.watchOut: State — офіційніше за say, часто про документи, правила, бланки. Порівняй: state clearly — сказати прямо; clearly imply — дати зрозуміти без прямих слів.

items.pattern: substantiate a claim / an allegation (with evidence) · formal
items.meaning: prove that a claim is true by giving evidence
items.example: The customer couldn't **substantiate her claim** that she'd paid for the extra bag.
more: Can you **substantiate** that **claim**, or is it just something you heard?
The museum couldn't **substantiate its claim** that the painting was by Rembrandt.
items.watchOut: Substantiate — офіційне слово; у розмові частіше back up a claim або prove it. Не плутай із substitute — замінювати.

items.pattern: strongly / firmly deny sth · strongly deny (that) … · strongly deny doing sth
items.meaning: say very firmly that something is not true
items.example: The bus company **strongly denies** that its drivers use their phones at the wheel.
more: The referee **strongly denied** that he had made a mistake.
The actor **strongly denied** the reports about his divorce.
items.watchOut: «Рішуче, категорично заперечувати» — strongly / firmly / categorically deny; decisively deny зазвичай не кажуть. Deny — заперечувати, що щось правда; «відмовлятися щось робити» — refuse.

items.pattern: deny the charges / an accusation · deny all (the) charges
items.meaning: say that you did not do what you are officially accused of
items.example: In court, the driver **denied the charges** and said the light had been green.
more: The teenager **denied the accusation** that he had started the fire.
The two shop owners **deny all the charges** of selling fake perfume.
items.watchOut: Charges — офіційне обвинувачення (поліція, суд), зазвичай у множині: deny the charges. «Не визнавати провини» — deny the charges, не refuse the charges.

items.pattern: deny a rumour / an allegation / a report · deny the rumours (about sth / that …)
items.meaning: say publicly that a rumour or allegation is not true
items.example: The supermarket has **denied the rumours** that it's going to stop selling fresh bread.
more: My cousin laughed and **denied the rumour** that she's getting married.
The company **denied the allegation** that it paid its staff late.
items.watchOut: «Чутки» — rumours, не hearings і не gossips (gossip — плітки, незлічуване: a lot of gossip). «Спростувати чутки» — deny the rumours, не refuse the rumours.

items.pattern: disclaim (all / any) responsibility for sth · formal
items.meaning: say officially that you are not responsible for something
items.example: The gym **disclaims all responsibility** for things left in the changing rooms.
more: The organisers **disclaim responsibility** for injuries during the fun run.
The school **disclaims all responsibility** for phones that pupils bring in.
items.watchOut: Disclaim — офіційне слово для оголошень, квитків, договорів. Простіше те саме — deny responsibility або accept no responsibility. Протилежне — accept / take responsibility.

items.pattern: reject an idea / a suggestion / a theory / a plan
items.meaning: say no to an idea or suggestion; refuse to accept it
items.example: The head teacher **rejected the suggestion** that pupils should wear trainers to school.
more: My flatmates **rejected the idea** of getting a cat.
The council **rejected the idea** of a car-free town centre.
items.watchOut: Ідею чи пропозицію не deny, а reject (або turn down). Deny — заперечувати, що щось правда. Запрошення чи пропозицію щось дати (an offer) частіше refuse, decline або turn down.

items.pattern: run contrary to sth · formal · contrary to popular belief
items.meaning: be the opposite of what people believe or expect
items.uk: суперечити чомусь, іти врозріз із чимось
items.example: The results of the survey **run contrary to** what most parents expected.
more: Eating late doesn't always make you put on weight. This **runs contrary to** what many people think.
**Contrary to popular belief**, bats are not blind.
items.watchOut: «Іти врозріз, суперечити» — run contrary to або run counter to, не run opposite to. Contrary to popular belief — «всупереч поширеній думці». Наголос у contrary — на перший склад.

items.pattern: contradictory evidence / advice / information / statements
items.meaning: evidence or advice in which one part says the opposite of another
items.example: My parents give me **contradictory advice**: Dad says I should buy a flat, Mum says I should rent.
more: The police had **contradictory evidence** about what time the shop was broken into.
The airline sent me **contradictory information**: one email said 9:00, another said 11:30.
items.watchOut: «Суперечливі поради» — contradictory або conflicting advice, не controversial: controversial — суперечливий у сенсі «який викликає суперечки в суспільстві» (a controversial law). Advice і evidence — незлічувані: не advices, не evidences.

items.pattern: deny / reject a claim (that …) · deny (that) …
items.meaning: say that a claim is not true, or refuse to accept it
items.example: The landlord **denied the claim** that the heating had been broken all winter.
more: The coach **rejected the claim** that he had favourite players.
Scientists **rejected the claim** that the water was dangerous to drink.
items.watchOut: З claim у значенні «твердження» — deny або reject, не refuse. Refuse a claim трапляється лише тоді, коли claim — це вимога грошей (наприклад, страхова виплата).

items.pattern: refuse an invitation / an offer (of sth) · decline / turn down an invitation
items.meaning: say no to something that someone kindly offers you
items.example: Jo **refused the invitation** to the office party because she doesn't like crowds.
more: It's hard to **refuse an offer** of free cake.
We politely **refused the invitation**: we already had plans.
items.watchOut: «Відмовитися від запрошення» — refuse the invitation, без from: не refuse from the offer. І не deny an invitation. Ввічливіше — decline, розмовне — turn down.

items.pattern: deny doing sth / having done sth · deny (that) …
items.meaning: say that you did not do something
items.example: My little sister **denied drawing** on the wall, but her hands were covered in green crayon.
more: He **denies taking** the money from the till.
My neighbour **denied that** she had parked in my space.
items.watchOut: Після deny — дієслово з -ing або that: deny taking, deny that I took, не deny to take. Порівняй: refuse to do sth — відмовлятися щось робити.

items.pattern: refuse to do sth
items.meaning: say firmly that you will not do something
items.example: Our cat **refuses to eat** anything except fish.
more: The taxi driver **refused to take** us because we had a big dog.
I **refuse to pay** for a meal I didn't order.
items.watchOut: Після refuse — to + дієслово: refuse to go, не refuse going і не refuse from going. Порівняй: deny doing sth — заперечувати, що щось зробив.

warmup.uk: Вона кинула прозорий натяк, що хоче цуценя.
warmup.q: She dropped a ___ hint that she wanted a puppy.
warmup.explain: Прозорий (очевидний) натяк — a heavy або broad hint. Thick hint і fat hint — кальки («товстий / жирний натяк»).

warmup.uk: Вона відкрито звинуватила брата в брехні.
warmup.q: She openly accused her brother ___ lying.
warmup.explain: Accuse sb of sth / of doing sth. Порівняй: blame sb for sth.

warmup.uk: Бабуся слушно зауважила: узимку квіти дорожчі.
warmup.q: Grandma ___ a good point: flowers cost more in winter.
warmup.explain: Слушно зауважити — make a (good) point. Do a point і say a point не кажуть.

warmup.uk: Мер спростував чутки про свою відставку.
warmup.q: The mayor denied the ___ about his resignation.
warmup.explain: Чутки — rumours. Gossip — плітки (незлічуване), hearing — слухання в суді чи комісії.
Ідею чи пропозицію відхиляють — reject (або turn down). Deny — заперечувати, що щось правда.

warmup.uk: Лікарі дають мені суперечливі поради: один каже відпочивати, інший — бігати.
warmup.q: Doctors keep giving me ___ advice: one says rest, another says run.
warmup.explain: Суперечливі поради — contradictory (або conflicting) advice. Controversial — той, що викликає суперечки в суспільстві. Disputable — спірний, сумнівний (який можна оскаржити).

warmup.uk: Нам довелося відмовитися від запрошення на весілля.
warmup.q: We had to ___ the wedding invitation.
warmup.explain: Відмовитися від запрошення — refuse (decline, turn down) an invitation, без from. Deny — заперечувати.

warmup.uk: Вона заперечує, що читала мій щоденник.
warmup.explain: Після deny — -ing або that + речення: denies reading / denies that she read.

A.q: Someone ___ the new parking rules to a local newspaper before they were announced.
A.explain: Таємно передати документ чи інформацію журналістам — leak. Pour і drip — про рідину.

A.q: Don't worry about the rumours that the factory is closing. They're completely ___.
A.explain: Unfounded — безпідставний. Unfunded — без фінансування, unfolded — розгорнутий.

A.q: The football fans have a ___ battle with the club over ticket prices.
A.explain: Long-running — тривалий, який триває вже давно. Long-distance і long-haul — про відстань (a long-distance call, a long-haul flight).

B.q: Have you got any facts to ___ up your argument?
B.explain: Back up an argument — підкріпити аргумент фактами.

B.q: Mozart is ___ acknowledged as one of the greatest composers.
B.explain: Widely acknowledged — визнаний багатьма, загальновизнаний. Highly acknowledged не кажуть.

B.q: The advert says the cream makes you look ten years younger, but the company can't ___ this claim.
B.explain: Substantiate a claim — підтвердити твердження доказами. Substitute — замінити, subscribe — підписатися.

C.q: When reporters asked about the money, the footballer ___ denied everything.
Bikes are left here at the owner's risk: the station ___ all responsibility for theft.
C.explain: Disclaim responsibility — офіційно знімати з себе відповідальність. Accept responsibility — навпаки, брати її на себе.

C.q: Many people think carrots help you see in the dark, but the science runs ___ to this.
C.explain: Run contrary to (або counter to) — суперечити. Run opposite to не кажуть.

M.q: The builder ___ the claim that he had used cheap materials.
M.explain: Claim (твердження) — deny або reject. Refuse і decline — відмовитися від того, що пропонують.

M.q: Do you deny ___ my sandwich? There are crumbs on your shirt!
M.explain: Після deny — дієслово з -ing: deny eating.

M.q: My son ___ to wear a hat, even when it's freezing.
M.explain: Відмовлятися щось робити — refuse to do sth. Deny — заперечувати, reject — відхиляти ідею чи пропозицію.

example.title: The missing cake
example.uk:
У п'ятницю з холодильника зник торт на сестрин день народження. Два дні Ольга кидала прозорі натяки, що знає, хто його з'їв, а в неділю відкрито звинуватила мене. Я, звісно, рішуче це заперечував. Мама висунула теорію: може, це зробив пес.

Ольга сказала, що це суперечить фактам: пес не міг відчинити холодильник. Тато давав нам лише суперечливі поради: спершу «Попроси вибачення», а потім «Ніколи не вибачайся за те, чого не робив».

Потім прийшов сусідський хлопчик, який був у нас у п'ятницю, — з порожньою тарілкою і винуватим обличчям. Звинувачення проти мене виявилися безпідставними: мене звинуватили несправедливо. Ольга цілком визнала, що помилялася, і дала мені найбільший шматок свого нового торта.
example.en:
My sister's birthday cake disappeared from the fridge on Friday. For two days Olga [[dropped heavy hints|a3]] that she knew who had eaten it, and on Sunday she [[openly accused|a7]] me. I [[strongly denied|c1]] it, of course. Mum [[put forward a theory|b1]]: maybe the dog had done it.

Olga said this [[ran contrary to|c6]] the facts: the dog couldn't open the fridge. Dad only gave us [[contradictory advice|c7]]: first 'Say sorry', then 'Never say sorry for something you didn't do.'

Then the boy next door, who had visited us on Friday, came round with an empty plate and a guilty face. The claims against me were [[unfounded|a9]]: I had been [[wrongly accused|a10]]. Olga [[fully accepted|b3]] that she was wrong and gave me the biggest piece of her new cake.
